about_the_game:
Unravel the mysteries of your past and shape your destiny in Enigma Heart, a side-scrolling action RPG that blends classic gameplay with modern sensibilities. Explore a war-torn kingdom, master magic and combat, and unlock new abilities to help you navigate the land and uncover hidden secrets.

Play as Zalia, a wanderer who awakens in a seaside village with no memory of who she is or why she was attacked. Nursed back to health by the local innkeeper Esme, Zalia embarks on a perilous journey to reclaim her lost past, protect those who have shown her kindness, and stand against the dark forces threatening Lufain. With a richly woven story, dynamic battles, and a sapphic love story at its heart, Enigma Heart delivers a nostalgic yet fresh take on the action RPG genre.

FEATURES

  • Vibrant exploration across the kingdom of Lufain, with hidden secrets, upgrades, and optional treasures waiting for you to discover

  • Unlockable abilities that enhance both combat and exploration

  • Dynamic combat system inspired by classic action RPGs, blending swordplay, magic, and strategic defense

  • Modes of transport that open up new areas and hidden locations to explore

  • Compelling narrative with deep, character-driven storytelling, including a sapphic love story at the heart of the adventure

  • Challenging puzzles and hidden tasks that reward players with unique upgrades and lore

  • Retro pixel art with a colorful, 16-bit-inspired aesthetic
